name: smwmusic-ys-iii-wanderers-from-ys-steeling-the-will-to-fight
title: Ys III: Wanderers from Ys - Steeling the Will to Fight
description:
One of stage themes from Ys III used in Elderm Mountains (known as Mt. Seko in the English localization of the Mega Drive and TurboGrafx-CD version). Based on the Mega Drive version of the song. Cound be used in underground levels.

(Note: The track name is taken from the official Ys: The Oath in Felghana soundtrack.)
